intro: Professionals and everyday users convert feet (ft) to meters (m) when working across imperial and si standards in architectural blueprints, international manufacturing tolerances, athletic track distances, and hardware sizing. One foot equals 0.3048 meters, while 1 meter equals 3.28084 feet. Whether you are verifying length specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Exact NIST Factor vs. Early Rounding Drift
items: The exact conversion factor from Foot to Meter is 0.3048, derived from the 1959 International Yard and Pound Agreement (1 inch = 25.4 mm, 1 lb = 0.45359237 kg).

In structural engineering, CNC machining, or bulk inventory totals, rounding the multiplier to 2 decimal places too early can introduce cumulative tolerance errors; always compute with the full factor and round only the final displayed figure.

faqs.question: How many meters (m) are in 1 foot (ft)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.3048 meters (m) in 1 foot (ft), which rounds to 0.3048 m for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 meter equals 3.28084 feet.

faqs.question: How do I convert feet to meters (ft to m)?
faqs.answer: To convert feet to meters, use the formula: m = ft × 0.3048. For example, converting 8 ft gives 2.4384 m.

faqs.question: What is 8 feet in meters?
faqs.answer: 8 feet (ft) equals exactly 2.4384 meters (m) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
